title: Surreal Einstein Portrait
description: A vibrant pop-art style portrait of Albert Einstein with yellow skin, wide eyes and tongue sticking out, set against a black background with white line drawings of hooded figures, pentagrams, scarabs and the word 'STATIS'. Colorful dripping balloons in pink, blue, yellow and purple float above his head alongside swirling lines, circles and lightning bolts.
prompt: surreal pop art portrait of Albert Einstein with bright yellow skin, wide crazy eyes and tongue out, white hair, floating above a dark mound covered in white line drawings of hooded cult figures, pentagrams, scarabs and the text STATIS, colorful dripping balloons in pink blue yellow and purple above his head, swirling energy rings and lightning bolts, graffiti style drips on a black background with neon green top border, vibrant chaotic composition
medium: spray paint and acrylic on canvas
